title: GitHub Copilot Adds Local Sandboxing at No Extra Cost
key_facts: Local sandboxing for GitHub Copilot is generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and VS Code sessions using Agent Host.
Tools and commands started by Copilot run with restricted access to files, network, credentials and other system capabilities.
It is powered by Microsoft eXecution Container (MXC), which turns one policy into native controls on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Organisations can use enterprise-managed settings to require sandboxing with policies developers cannot weaken.
It applies to local MCP and language servers where supported.
Sandbox policies apply regardless of which model Copilot uses.
It is included with GitHub Copilot at no additional cost.
quote_evidence: Local sandboxing for GitHub Copilot is now generally available in GitHub Copilot CLI, the GitHub Copilot app, and VS Code sessions using Agent Host.

why_it_matters_hint: Lets developers and companies give coding agents more freedom inside set limits.
